scope: Resolve KY-VF62-06 for ky_misdemeanor_expungement-set; no packet or commercial admission.

decisions.bindingProductRule: List on the face of AOC-496.2 only charges actually resulting in conviction, preserving the printed paragraph 1 attestation. For same-criminal-action misdemeanor, violation, or traffic-infraction charges dismissed or amended that KRS 431.078(1) permits to be expunged, use an incorporated Supplemental Schedule of Companion Charges. Each supplemental charge preserves original offense; amendment destination, if any; actual disposition; disposition date; case number; and related final conviction where applicable. Never characterize an amended-away or dismissed charge as a conviction. Do not alter the printed AOC-496.2 attestation. Do not apply this rule to felony companion charges: fail closed and route those through independently applicable felony/nonconviction authority.
